<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex10032023-07-2412-45-04" status="reviewed"><l>thugs sbyangs stobs kyis smra ba'i seng ger grags ||</l>
         <l>nyi zla bzhin du ma rig nyon mongs sel ||</l>
         <l>bsdu' bzhis bdag sogs 'gon med smin grol mdzad ||</l>
         <l>zung 'jug mtshan don ldan pa khyed la 'dud ||</l>
         
         <l>chos kyis 'phongs pa'i <abbr>sems can</abbr> la ||</l>
         <l>rgyas 'bring rtogs pas tshim mdzad pa ||</l>
         <l><lb n="108a5"/> de bzhin bdag gis <abbr>sems can</abbr> rnams ||</l>
         <l>'phrin las rnaMs kyis tshim byed shog ||</l>
         
         <l>bla ma bde' bar gshegs pa'i gsung zab cing rgya che ba thugs<anchor xml:id="a1"/> su chud nas gzhan la ston pas 'khor ba'i mun nag du 'khyaMs pa'i long khrid pa ||</l>
         <l>         <anchor xml:id="a2"/>         dbu' ma chen pos gdul bya mngon mtho' nges legs la 'god pas thar pa dang <abbr>thams cad</abbr> mkhyen pa'i skyed byed ||</l><anchor xml:id="a3"/></seg></TEI>
